# Eco Pak Services

> Eco Pak Services is an environmental testing, laboratory, consultancy and engineering company headquartered in Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan (established 2015). Official website: https://ecopakservices.com/

Contact: info@ecopakservices.com · +92 300 1050996 · +92 300 1050977

- [Contact](https://ecopakservices.com/contact)

## Environmental testing (laboratory)
- [Environmental Laboratory Services](https://ecopakservices.com/services/environmental-laboratory): air, stack, vehicular emission, noise, water, wastewater, industrial hygiene
- [Water & Wastewater Testing](https://ecopakservices.com/services/water-wastewater-testing)
- [Air Quality & Stack Emission Testing](https://ecopakservices.com/services/air-quality-stack-emission-testing)

- [Techno-Legal Services](https://ecopakservices.com/services/techno-legal)
